📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Jember just put down The Focus Group... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

🛡️ Everett, Rim, Ursula, Greta and Sari met them at the door — 2 put down, 3 barely walked away. Everett, Rim, Ursula, Greta, Sari are hurt.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Rim just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."
🛡️ Everett, Jember, Rim, Ursula and Nina met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 driven off, 1 barely walked away. Everett, Jember, Rim, Nina are hurt.

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Grace just put down Buffering... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sigrun just put down Ugly-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.
Maya strikes the Pack-leader The Ugly Beast.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader The Ugly Beast (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.
Nina strikes the Pack-leader The Ugly Beast.
The Pack-leader The Ugly Beast falls.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Big Stare... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Sigrun and Maya met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 driven off. Sigrun is hurt.
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Maya just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.

killerTaleLog: [day 13] Chen: The fire settles. Chen has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Mountain Lord — I put it down today." "It crouches low, tail lashing once, twice. The stripes go still. Then it comes." "A paw rises, claws out — casual, almost lazy. It is not lazy." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Cheyenne says "And you're still standing." Greta mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 13] Cheyenne: The fire settles. Cheyenne has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Anaconda Empress — I put it down today." "The water bulges — a ripple with intent." "It loosens, reluctantly, and pours itself back into the water. It will remember this pool." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nina asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Sari says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 13] Everett: The fire settles. Everett has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Cliffhanger — I put it down today." "It goes perfectly still. Only the eyes move. Then the water explodes — and the world starts spinning." "It has your leg. The roll starts. Do NOT let it reach the water." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nina asks "The fire feels smaller now." Sari asks "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 18] Greta: The fire settles. Greta has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hushpuppy — I put it down today." "No telegraph you can hear. Watch the birds — when they go quiet, the pack is already moving." "The pack circles — nips from the edge, never committing." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Chen mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Grace breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 18] Jember: The fire settles. Jember has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Union Rep — I put it down today." "'BROTHERS! SISTERS!' Allied monsters hit harder. The speech is the weapon." "'WHO'S WITH ME?' Help is coming." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Greta says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Nina asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 21] Everett: The fire settles. Everett has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nostalgia — I put it down today." "The air fills with light — YOUR memories, projected huge. The beam follows your gaze. MOVE." "The reel stutters — outtakes. Embarrassing ones. Close up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jember mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Sari says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 21] Cheyenne: The fire settles. Cheyenne has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Moderator — I put it down today." "It reviews you. 'Content noted.' A weak ranging chip while it decides." "'REMOVAL NOTICE.' Defiant or compliant — the hammer is coming down." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rim says quietly "Did it look at you? Before?" Ursula mutters "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 24] Nina: The fire settles. Nina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Understudy — I put it down today." "It watches your weapon. It lifts its own — a perfect, insulting copy at half fidelity." "It starts performing — and your most-used move is suddenly anticipated, halved, ANSWERED." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Grace says "Did it look at you? Before?" Cheyenne asks "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 27] Everett: The fire settles. Everett has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Static — I put it down today." "It finds your voice in the static. It WEARS it. 'Help— help me—' in YOUR voice. Moving won't help once it has you." "It drops the voice. No static, no words — it RUSHES, no telegraph at all. Back off." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jember mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Chen says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 27] Rim: The fire settles. Rim has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Tick — I put it down today." "It waits. The questing legs wave — the tell." "Adjacent = attached. No dodge. It's ON you." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Greta breathes "We've been walking past those." Sari says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 28] Nina: The fire settles. Nina has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Landlord — I put it down today." "It plants a sign in the ground around you. NOTICE SERVED. The ground is claimed." "You ended your turn on claimed ground. The rent is due. It rises with every Addendum." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Chen mutters "Say that again — slower." Rim says quietly "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 29] Jember: The fire settles. Jember has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Focus Group — I put it down today." "The murmur rises — you can HEAR them deliberating. They're about to love your dodge and hate your strike. The ratings are honest and visible." "The lead mouth-head clears its throat — the opening question, focus-grouped and focus-grouped again: ‘So... how does that make you FEEL?’" A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikos says quietly "Say that again — slower." Grace mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 30] Greta: The fire settles. Greta has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Ursula says "And you're still standing." Sari mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 32] Nikos: The fire settles. Nikos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Inspiration — I put it down today." "It brightens. The light is too white, too certain. EUREKA — the biggest burst so far." "It flickers — a smaller, meaner idea. Less certain, faster." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Jember breathes "And you're still standing." Chen says "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 35] Nikos: The fire settles. Nikos has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Drum-Belly — I put it down today." "It rears up, belly swelling drum-taut, and beats it with both paws — BOOM. The air itself flinches." "It waddles left, then is suddenly right — a feint, testing whether your eyes or your ears are in charge." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Everett says "And you're still standing." Greta says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 37] Jember: The fire settles. Jember has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Heckler — I put it down today." "'You call that a swing?' The words CUT. Shame stacks." "'Oh, it's TRYING again!' Double shame — it smells blood." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Everett says quietly "So it bleeds." Ursula breathes "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 59] Everett: The fire settles. Everett has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Paparazzo — I put it down today." "The flash charges — whine rising. When it fires, you freeze in place." "Every shot refines its model — hit or miss. At 4, the money shot is unavoidable." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rim asks "So it bleeds." Nikos breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 59] Jember: The fire settles. Jember has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nina breathes "Tell me you didn't go alone." Nikos asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 59] Grace: The fire settles. Grace has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikos mutters "So it bleeds." Jember mutters "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 137] Maya: The fire settles. Maya has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Herald — I put it down today." "It raises its trumpet. A line of sky goes WHITE — that's where the sound will land. MOVE." "It turns, slowly, and TWO patches of sky go white. It is showing you where NOT to stand. Split up." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Sigrun asks "The fire feels smaller now." Greta says "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
vetKillerTaleLog: [day 110] Sigrun: The fire settles. Sigrun leans in, and the hall goes quiet in a different way — this is not a new story. "You all know Ugly-Eyes by now. I put another one down today." "The narration itself — it tells you what's coming, honestly, always: 'and then they ran.' The spotlight narrows as the story nears its end. It's a doom counter that gains weight each round. When the story finishes, you die — unless you've changed the narrative." "It carves while it speaks — your name, a date, a line about potential. ‘Here lies—’ The chisel is the telegraph." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Greta breathes "We've been walking past those." Nina asks "The fire feels smaller now." Someone at the edge of the light nods, slow. "We know the name. We know the hand, too."
